package: Sandero / Sandero Stepway MY26 2026-11-02 cennik reconciliation

source.title: DACIA SANDERO I SANDERO STEPWAY cennik MY26 2026-11-02
source.notes: Official Polish Sandero/Sandero Stepway MY26 9-page cennik effective 2026-11-02. Pages 1-4: 15 of 19 catalogue prices increase by 500 PLN; four Hybrid 155 prices unchanged; six-grade equipment/options/packages reconciled. Added 27 missing Hybrid 155 equipment availability observations and 24 scalar observations for wheels, upholstery and central console; corrected four Stepway Expression rear-camera mappings to standard. Page 5 technical data: 42 observations added/reconciled, including WLTP, VDA luggage volume and Hybrid 155 injection/acceleration/electric-motor torque. Eco-G injection and LPG tank-capacity semantics are deferred against the Jogger cennik cross-check. Page 6: 27 Sandero dimension observations added/reconciled; 1,853 mm body width resolves conflicting 1,753 mm configurator values; interior callouts without safe attribute mapping deferred. Pages 7-9 reviewed; accessory catalogue without prices, separate winter-wheel list effective 2026-09-01 and commercial/finance campaigns are deferred. Raw PDF bytes unavailable for archiving; SHA-256 unavailable.

commercial_items.name: Lakier metalizowany
commercial_items.notes: The official 2026-11-02 cennik PDF page 3 presents one combined row: 'Lakier metalizowany lub niemetalizowany specjalny'. The 2,600/2,800 PLN pair for Stepway Expression/Extreme is stored as two finish alternatives in the printed label order; single 2,600 PLN cells are retained for both alternatives. No named colour assignment is inferred.

commercial_items.name: Lakier niemetalizowany specjalny
commercial_items.notes: The official 2026-11-02 cennik, page 3, labels metallic or special non-metallic paint and prints 2,600/2,800 PLN for Stepway Expression/Extreme. The single 2,600 PLN cells are applied to both finish types; the slash pair is interpreted in label order. No named colour assignment is inferred.

commercial_items.name: Koło zapasowe + podnośnik
commercial_items.notes: The official 2026-11-02 cennik, page 3, lists 800 PLN and explicitly excludes LPG configurations.
